name: Video Quality (CRF Encoding)
summary: Re-encodes video frames using Constant Rate Factor (CRF) to allocate bits where motion and detail demand them most.
analogy: A court reporter writing fast in shorthand during frantic moments and using neat handwriting during quiet pauses.
what_you_gain: 50-80% file size reduction for raw screen captures, home videos, and large video recordings.
what_you_lose: Video compression is CPU-intensive; fine background noise or dark gradient banding may become slightly visible.
best_for: Large video captures, tutorial recordings, and mobile video archives.
avoid_for: Raw camera footage (ProRes/RAW) intended for professional video editing or color grading.
go_deeper: H.264 / H.265 / AV1 codecs divide video into macroblocks, performing spatial intra-prediction and temporal motion estimation.
